name: Can I customize the design of my tiny home?

mainEntity.name: Can I customize the design of my tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, customization is a core part of the Zen Tiny Homes process. We offer a range of customizable floor plans and design options to ensure your tiny home reflects your personal style and meets your specific functional needs. You can choose finishes, fixtures, built-in storage solutions, and even modify layouts. Our design team works closely with you to incorporate your preferences while adhering to structural integrity and local building codes. We aim to create a space that feels uniquely yours.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we offer extensive customization options for your tiny home's design, finishes, and layout to match your personal style and needs.
